title.zh: Blockchain.com申请CFTC批准以在美国提供预测市场和加密衍生品
title.en: Blockchain.com seeks CFTC greenlight for US prediction markets, crypto derivatives trading: CNBC

current_state.zh: Blockchain.com has applied to the CFTC for designated contract market and futures commission merchant licenses so it can offer prediction-market event contracts and crypto derivatives directly to U.S. retail and institutional customers, joining a wave of firms seeking federal derivatives approvals.
current_state.en: Blockchain.com has applied to the CFTC for designated contract market and futures commission merchant licenses so it can offer prediction-market event contracts and crypto derivatives directly to U.S. retail and institutional customers, joining a wave of firms seeking federal derivatives approvals.
